_doc: Negative-proof ledger introduced for the fork dependency gate. Exact historical gate paths are excluded until their own controls are changed and proved; future undisclosed gates remain discoverable.

gates.description: Rejects `git push` in adapter/runtime source, and rejects its own run when it could not read what it was supposed to scan: an absent/renamed REQUIRED scan root, a required root present but holding zero scannable files, an unreadable directory or file, an unresolvable or dangling symlink, or zero files scanned overall. Directory symlinks are resolved and traversed (cycle-safe) rather than silently dropped.

observedFailure.command: node scripts/check-no-git-push.mjs (run in a scratch fixture whose four scan roots were renamed, with the offending file still on disk)
observedFailure.reason: Exited 2 with 'scanned 0 files and therefore cannot report a pass' and named all four absent roots. Under real EPERM the same run exits 2 with 'cannot list directory packages/adapters/deep: EPERM' and 'cannot read packages/adapters/evil.ts: EPERM'. The pre-fix script exited 0 printing the success line in all three cases, having read nothing.
observedFailure.restoredPass: With the roots restored and readable, the same fixture exits 0 and prints the denominator '4 file(s) scanned across 4 of 4 scan root(s)'; a seeded offender still exits 1 and names the file and line. Against the real checkout the gate reports 1273 files scanned across 4 of 4 roots.
observedFailure.preFixTestRun: Run against a scratch copy of the pre-fix module (94a4a440c), the suite is 14 pass / 8 fail; against the fixed module it is 22 pass / 0 fail. The 8 are the seven new #76 fixtures plus the happy-path assertion that the pass line carries a non-zero scanned-file count.

reopened.why: The first #76 fix left three working bypasses. Each was reproduced against the frozen pre-fix module (79dcf8e1d) with a live control before any code changed.

bypasses.summary: readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}) reports a symlink-to-directory with isDirectory()===false, so the entry fell to the FILE branch, failed the extension test on its extension-less name, and its ENTIRE subtree was dropped silently.
bypasses.observedPreFix: exit 0, "4 file(s) scanned across 4 of 4 scan root(s)", offender readable on disk through the link. Every telemetry signal read healthy because the denominator counted ROOTS, not the tree.
bypasses.committable: git stores the link as mode 120000 with blob content "../../hidden" (verified with git ls-files -s in a scratch repo), so a Linux CI checkout materialises a real symlink and takes the same branch. Not Windows-only.
bypasses.observedPostFix: exit 1, naming packages/adapters/deep/evil.ts through the link.

bypasses.summary: Renaming ONE of four scan roots -- the one holding the offender -- was merely logged. Only renaming ALL FOUR tripped the vacuity guard.
bypasses.observedPreFix: exit 0 with "3 file(s) scanned across 3 of 4 scan root(s)" and the offender readable under the renamed directory.
bypasses.observedPostFix: exit 2, "required scan roots ABSENT: packages/adapter-utils". Absence is now decided BY DECLARATION: a bare string root is required (fail-closed default), tolerance must be written as { path, optional: true }. A required root that exists but yields zero scannable files also fails closed.

bypasses.summary: SCANNABLE_EXTENSIONS omitted .mts/.cts/.jsx, so an offender renamed to .mts was never read.
bypasses.observedPreFix: exit 0 with the offender unscanned whenever any sibling .ts file padded the file count.
bypasses.observedPostFix: exit 1 for each of .mts/.cts/.jsx; .d.mts/.d.cts remain skipped as declarations.

reopened.preFixTestRun: The committed suite run against a scratch shim over the frozen pre-fix module (79dcf8e1d) is 21 pass / 17 fail; against the fixed module it is 38 pass / 0 fail / 0 skipped. The 17 are every bypass fixture plus the four pre-existing fixtures that relied on blanket tolerance of an absent root.
reopened.notARegressionFixture: The symlink-cycle test passes against the pre-fix module too, because pre-fix never followed a directory symlink and so could not loop. It guards the hazard the fix introduces, not a bypass.
reopened.coverageDelta: On the real checkout the file count is unchanged at 1273 (there are no committed symlinks and no .mts/.cts/.jsx under the scan roots today), so this closes adversarial and future holes without altering current coverage. The pass line now reports the TREE: "1273 file(s) scanned across 114 director(ies), 0 symlink(s) resolved; per root: packages/adapters=247, packages/adapter-utils=55, server/src=820, cli/src=151".
reopened.wiring: Until now the gate ran in ZERO automated contexts for dev work: its only caller was .github/workflows/pr.yml, triggered on pull_request: branches:[master], while all development happens on dev. It is now also a step in the local pre-push tier (scripts/pre-push-check.ps1 and .sh).

gates.description: Fork PR dependency-bearing changes fail unless a trusted maintainer applies the dependency-review-approved label.

observedFailure.reason: Exited 1 and reported that dependency-bearing files changed without the trusted dependency-review-approved label.
observedFailure.restoredPass: With only README.md modified, the same gate exited 0 and emitted passed=true.

gates.description: Classifies dependency-bearing PR files and enforces explicit trusted-label approval on fork repositories.

observedFailure.reason: Exited 1 for the deliberately unapproved package.json change and named the missing trusted label as the cause.
observedFailure.restoredPass: With only README.md modified, the script exited 0 and emitted passed=true.

gates.description: Runs only an exact local React Doctor package and emits a normalized receipt.

observedFailure.reason: The temporary checkout had no node_modules/react-doctor. The runner returned exit 2 and JSON error pinned-package-missing with outcome=incomplete; no npx or package-manager fallback was available.
observedFailure.restoredPass: The test creates a temporary exact 0.7.8 package whose local analyzer returns JSON; the runner exits 0 with outcome=passed and 64-character package/output hashes.

gates.description: Stops on pre-commit checker failure and preserves real analyzer failures while allowing only the explicit unconfigured state.

observedFailure.command: node --test scripts/run-react-doctor.test.mjs --test-name-pattern="preserves a real analyzer failure exit code"
observedFailure.reason: The temporary exact 0.7.8 analyzer emits valid JSON and exits 23; the runner receipt is outcome=failed, error=analyzer-reported-failure, exitCode=23. The hook allows only exit 2 for missing configuration and exits for any other nonzero status.
observedFailure.restoredPass: The paired local-analyzer test exits 0 with outcome=passed, while the missing-package case remains the explicit disabled receipt path rather than a false quality pass.
